ms.promise:
(A) Authorization Screens
(B) Create Event Page, connecting wallet, UI+UX
(C) User Profile Page
(D) Featured Event Page
ms.criteria:
(A) Front end work for Authorization Screens will include any relevant details to verify users accounts.
(B) Create event page will include the workflow for users to list an event on the Cardano Calendar platform.
(C) Screens for user profile will contain relevant data for accounts such as name, stats, and other relevant data
(D) Featured event page will include the workflow for creating an event on the platform as well as other additional UI elements for the featured listing.
ms.report: We have completed the user profile login page, the user flow for event creation, featured event page, and authorization screens. Please see the attached video https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yex9pIu4m-taW0ISDzoP5X-zxYk1fODe/view?usp=sharing

ms.promise:
(A) Events (comments, reactions)
(B) User Profile (bio, events, wallet, tags)
(C) Setup of production server
ms.criteria:
(A) Coding and logic is working for the create event workflow
(B) User profiles are able to show all relevant data related to user accounts
(C) Hosting providers with are established to maintain the site once live
ms.report: This is a resubmission for POA Milestone 2. Our team has made progress with the event creation workflow, user profile pages, sign in verification, and the setup of the production server. Our code can be seen in Swagger - > https://api-staging.cardanocalendar.io/docs/static/index.html Please feel free to test the platform at cardanocalendar.io Here is a short video showing our current progress -> https://drive.google.com/file/d/1gmfuvnyJs_hGjJIuQysLIS8Tx-Vmup--/view?usp=sharing

ms.promise:
(A) Notification service
(B) Reminders and Email sending
ms.criteria:
(A) Users can setup notifications to get alerts about events which they are attending
(B) Integration with common calendar applications allow users to get reminders and emails
ms.report: We have completed integration with Google Calendar. The attached link shows a demo of using the platform with such functionality. We have also completed email notifications. We have also attached the text which appears when a user receives an email from the platform. We have attached this as a Google Doc in order to prevent spam emails. https://drive.google.com/file/d/13lVplgTbOy1HHhcep5qc0Y9DmIV5zPWy/view?usp=sharing https://docs.google.com/document/d/1wpTd_7OeGFPO-v6apNN1fa6hi0n5Ov-RZkaT7vklyLk/edit?usp=sharing
